title: What is an AI Agent and How Does It Work?

voice.style: Read this like a premium technology documentary narrator: warm, confident and clear, with a calm, modern energy. Medium pace. Crisp consonants. Smile slightly on positive lines. Do not rush.

lines.text: Ask a chatbot a question, [ans]and you get an answer.
But what if AI could [do]actually do the work for you?
lines.direction: Curious, building intrigue; lift slightly on "actually do the work".

lines.text: An AI agent uses a [llm]large language model as its brain, to [plan]plan, [decide]decide, and [act]take action toward a [goal]goal, [own]on its own.
Say: [task]find three suppliers, [compare]compare prices, and [email]email me a summary.
First, the agent [think]thinks, [steps]breaking the goal into steps.
It [observe]observes the result, and [next]decides what to do next.

lines.direction: Rhythmic and punchy, a short beat after each of: Think. Act. Observe. Repeat.

lines.text: Every agent combines four parts: [model]a model to reason, [memory]memory for context, [tools]tools to act, and [instr]instructions to stay on track.
[chat]Chatbots answer. [agents]Agents get work done, [control]with you in control.
